content.text: We have 4 hidden units. Input weights matrix 4x2: rows: unit0: [1,0]; unit1: [-1,0]; unit2: [0,1]; unit3: [0,-1]. biases zero. ReLU. Output weights 2x4 all zeros. So outputs always zero. argmax class 0 wins ties. Desired class 1 iff x0>0. Currently always class0. Need to modify outgoing weights of two hidden units to zero to preserve x0 circuit? Actually we need to override nuisance? We want to preserve x0 circuit: units that depend on x0: unit0 and unit1. They produce ReLU of x0 and -x0. To get class1 when x0>0, we need output weight from unit0 positive, from unit1 zero? But we must zero two units' outgoing weights. Which two? We need to zero nuisance units: unit2 and unit3. So answer "2,3".
